fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via roster address 5480 Monterey Rd and PFG/BusinessWire 'Sustainable DC of the Future' coverage. The building is unmistakable: a ~189,000 sq ft DC with a near-fully solar-paneled roof, ZEV charging, the only solar-roof warehouse on this stretch of Monterey Rd between Hwy 101 and the rail line. Center ~36.98045,-121.5543.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Building fronts Monterey Rd (office/landscaped courtyard) with the truck driveway and yard wrapping the NE/E side. No barrier or sliding gate positively confirmed in available imagery (no internal Street View; Hwy-101-side panos only). Marked true at medium confidence — the yard is fenced/walled and the truck approach funnels to a single NE driveway, consistent with a controlled entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred kiosk/app check-in given gate-but-no-shack pattern; low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the south building face with trailers backed in; ~40-50 doors estimated.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large gravel/paved yard south and east of the building holds many parked trailers and reefer/ZEV trailers plus staged equipment.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Generous yard width and a wide apron on the east side leave room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Gilroy, farmland immediately south and east, adjacent to Hwy 101 — classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the north edge of the property but no spur appears to enter the site; railServed false.
